jobs.title: Global Director, Marketing Operations
jobs.description:
Build the global operating engine behind world-class growth

Marketing doesn't scale by accident. It scales through exceptional operations, world-class insights, smart technology and outstanding leadership.

We're looking for a Global Director of Marketing Operations to define, build and lead a best-in-class Marketing Operations function that powers the next stage of our growth.

This is a rare opportunity to shape how a global B2B SaaS organisation plans, executes, measures and optimises marketing. You'll own the strategy, build the capability and create the operating model that enables high-performing teams across every region.

This isn't about inheriting a finished function. It's about setting the vision, building an exceptional global team and creating the systems, processes, insights and technology that become a competitive advantage for the business.

If you believe Marketing Operations should sit at the heart of commercial decision-making, this is your opportunity to prove it.

What you'll own

You'll define and lead the global Marketing Operations strategy, ensuring every region operates with the same high standards while enabling local teams to move with speed and confidence.

Your remit will span:

- Defining the global Marketing Operations vision, strategy and operating model that supports ambitious international growth

- Building the planning and operating rhythms that connect global strategy with regional execution

- Creating world-class marketing analytics, performance reporting and executive insight that influence business decisions at every level

- Developing sophisticated attribution and measurement frameworks that connect marketing investment directly to pipeline, revenue and long-term customer value

- Owning global marketing planning, forecasting and budget management, ensuring investment is aligned to commercial priorities

- Leading the evolution of our global marketing technology ecosystem, creating a scalable, integrated platform that enables growth across every market

- Driving the adoption of AI across Marketing Operations, identifying practical applications that improve productivity, decision-making, campaign effectiveness and customer experience

- Establishing global standards for operational excellence, governance, process design and data quality

- Partnering with Marketing, Revenue Operations, Sales, Finance, Product and executive leadership to create a world-class global go-to-market operating model

- Embedding a culture of experimentation, measurement and continuous optimisation across every marketing team worldwide

Build a team others benchmark against

This is as much a leadership opportunity as it is an operational one.

You'll recruit, develop and inspire a high-performing global Marketing Operations organisation, creating an environment where exceptional people can do the best work of their careers.

You'll define how the function is structured, how it partners with the business and the standards it becomes known for.

Our ambition is straightforward: build the best damn Marketing Operations function in SaaS.

Who you are

You're already operating at a senior level within Marketing Operations and have helped scale high-growth B2B SaaS businesses through operational excellence.

You think globally while executing pragmatically. You're commercially minded, deeply analytical and comfortable moving between board-level strategy discussions and the technical detail of marketing systems, attribution models or AI-enabled workflows.

You'll likely bring:

- Significant leadership experience within Marketing Operations in high-growth B2B SaaS

- Experience designing and leading global Marketing Operations functions across multiple regions and markets

- Deep expertise in marketing strategy, operations, analytics, attribution, planning, forecasting and performance management

- Strong commercial judgement with a proven ability to influence executive decision-making through insight and data

- Experience owning substantial global marketing budgets and investment planning

- A track record of building, developing and leading exceptional international teams through periods of rapid growth and transformation

- Extensive experience with modern marketing technology, CRM platforms, automation, data architecture and operational design

- Practical experience identifying and implementing AI capabilities that deliver measurable business impact

- Outstanding leadership, communication and stakeholder management skills, with the credibility to influence senior executives across a global organisation

- High standards, intellectual curiosity and a relentless focus on continuous improvement

Why join us?

This is a career-defining opportunity.

You'll shape how marketing operates globally. You'll influence executive strategy. You'll build an exceptional international team. You'll own the technology roadmap, redefine how marketing performance is measured and help lead the next generation of AI-enabled marketing capability.

Most importantly, you'll have the freedom, autonomy and backing to build something exceptional.

Not simply an efficient Marketing Operations function.

Build the team. Define the standards. Set the pace for an industry.

What’s in it for you?

- Equity participation in our innovative mission to combat financial crime Unlimited Time Off Policy to promote work-life balance and well-being

- We embrace a hybrid approach that requires employees to be in the office for two days a week. We strongly believe that this approach fosters collaboration and enables the building of meaningful relationships

- Opportunities for collaboration and career development with smart, like-minded professionals

- Annual learning budget to support professional growth

- A home office budget to support working from home

- Enhanced parental leave and childcare benefits

- Life insurance and medical coverage through BUPA, including pre-existing conditions

- Pension contribution through The People's Pension

jobs.title: Manager- Business Development
jobs.description:
About ComplyAdvantage

ComplyAdvantage is the financial industry’s leading source of AI-driven financial crime risk data and detection technology. Our mission is to neutralize the risk of money laundering, terrorist financing, corruption, and other financial crimes.

More than 1,000 companies globally rely on us to navigate risk through the world’s only real-time database of people and companies. Backed by Goldman Sachs, Ontario Teachers’, Index Ventures, and Balderton Capital, we have raised over $100M to date. After growing our team by 40% last year, we are scaling from 500 to 600+ people - and our SDR team is the engine behind that growth.

The role

This is a people-leadership role first. As Head of Business Development for EMEA, you own the outbound business development (BDR) function across the region — hiring, developing, and leading a team of BDRs whose job is to generate qualified pipeline for our new-business sales organization.

You will set the outbound strategy, build the ramp and coaching systems that make reps successful, and create the career pathways that turn strong BDRs into future account executives. Your success is measured by the performance, retention, and progression of the team you build — and by the quality of pipeline they generate for the business.

What you’ll do

- Lead and coach the team. Run daily coaching, call reviews, and 1:1s that raise the performance of every BDR — developing outbound craft, resilience, and commercial judgment across the group.

- Own the hiring bar. Run a structured, competency-based interview process, and keep a bench of talent ahead of demand so the team can scale without dropping quality.

- Design onboarding and ramp. Build and run a structured 90-day onboarding program with clear milestone gates, so new hires reach full productivity faster.

- Build career pathways. Maintain a competency framework with assessable junior and senior behaviors, and create clear BDR-to-AE progression that helps you attract and retain ambitious reps.

- Set the outbound strategy. Define account prioritization, ideal-customer-profile targeting, messaging, and multi-channel sequencing across EMEA, in partnership with Sales and Marketing.

- Own pipeline generation. Carry the team’s qualified-pipeline target, forecast opportunities into the new-business funnel, and use data to diagnose and fix what is not working.

- Partner across the business. Work with Revenue Operations on tooling, routing, reporting, and compensation design, and align closely with Marketing on account-based programs.

- Report on performance. Give sales leadership a clear, evidence-based view of team health, ramp, and pipeline contribution.

Proficient with:

- Cognism

- Salesforce

- Sales Nav

- Clay

- Building multi-outreach

- Insights into performing channels

What you’ll bring

People-management experience is essential. We are looking for someone with a strong track record of managing an outbound BDR or SDR team — you have hired, coached, and retained reps and led a team to target, not only carried a number yourself.

- Team leadership. Proven experience leading and developing outbound BDRs/SDRs, with a genuine interest in growing people and a record of moving reps into more senior roles.

- Building the function. Experience designing or scaling onboarding, ramp, coaching, and performance frameworks — not just running the ones you inherited.

- Outbound craft. Strong command of prospecting, multi-channel sequencing, and qualification (MEDDIC or a similar framework), with the ability to teach it.

- Data fluency. Comfortable in Salesforce and reporting tools, using metrics to manage a team, forecast pipeline, and make decisions.

- Commercial background. Experience selling or generating pipeline in B2B SaaS; exposure to RegTech, FinTech, financial services, or compliance is an advantage.

- The right blend. The emotional intelligence to develop people, and the operational rigor to run a team at scale across multiple markets.

Nice to have

- Experience building or managing teams across multiple EMEA markets.

- Familiarity with anti-money laundering (AML), sanctions, or wider financial crime compliance.

- Experience partnering with Marketing on account-based experience (ABX) or account-based marketing (ABM) programs.

How we work

Our values shape how this team operates, and we hire for them:

- Make a safer world. The work matters — we help stop the movement of funds that fuel serious crime.

- Raise the bar. We hold a high standard for ourselves and each other, and we keep getting better.

- See it, own it, drive it forward. We take ownership and follow through.

- Win as one team. We succeed together, across functions and regions.

jobs.title: Regional Marketing Manager - EMEA
jobs.description:
The Regional Marketing Manager, EMEA, serves as the voice of marketing in the EMEA region. You will partner closely with regional sales teams, execute localized activation plans and events, tailor content for regional relevance and feed key market and competitive insights back into the business. While our global marketing team builds campaigns, content, branding and paid programs, this role is all about accountability, orchestration, regional execution and local impact. You will own the regional marketing budget, track performance, optimize local programs and build strong alignment with the EMEA sales organization.

What you’ll do:

- Translate global marketing campaigns into regionally relevant programmes by localising content (including translation if needed), adapting messaging for market or regulatory differences and running regional activations.

- Plan, execute and own all regional marketing activities including local face-to-face events, sponsorships of industry conferences, regional webinars, co-marketing partnerships and third-party events.

- Own and manage the EMEA marketing budget by estimating costs, managing spend, tracking ROI and performance, reporting results and recommending ongoing optimizations.

- Act as the key liaison between the global marketing team and the EMEA sales organisation to ensure sales understand target markets, personas and campaign materials; gather feedback from sales; and ensure marketing-to-sales hand-off is smooth and measurable.

- Monitor the regional competitive landscape and market trends to identify emerging opportunities, local nuances, and regulatory changes, feeding actionable insights back into the global marketing team to shape future strategy and content.

- Build and execute regional marketing plans aligned with global strategy by setting regional goals, defining timelines and metrics and adjusting based on local market conditions and performance.

- Manage regional vendors, partners and agencies by coordinating logistics for events, negotiating sponsorship deals, overseeing execution and managing translation and localisation services.

- Ensure brand consistency and governance across all regional initiatives by aligning every activity with global brand guidelines, messaging and marketing frameworks.

- Track, measure and communicate performance of all regional marketing initiatives by reporting on pipeline contribution, event ROI, marketing-influenced leads and other key metrics to both regional sales leadership and the global marketing team.

- Develop and strengthen regional relationships and partnerships by identifying opportunities for co-marketing with local ecosystems such as industry associations, influencers and channel or partner networks.

What we’re looking for:

- Minimum of three (3) years of B2B SaaS marketing experience in a fast-growing scale-up environment (ideally with exposure to regional/field marketing or regional campaign activation).

- Experience working in EMEA markets including event planning/execution, sponsorships, localization/translation of marketing content.

- Experience in B2B SaaS event marketing, both owned events and third-party industry events (speaking panels, trade shows, webinars) in an EMEA context.

- Proven ability to collaborate with global marketing/central teams and regional sales teams; comfort working in a matrixed organization.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills; strong attention to detail; highly organized and able to manage multiple projects concurrently.

- Metrics-driven mindset: ability to track budget, measure campaign performance (leads, pipeline, ROI), provide insights and optimization recommendations.

- Experience managing external agencies/venues/partners: vendor negotiation, logistics management and coordination.

- Self-starter, collaborative team player, comfortable as the regional marketing “owner” and regional go-to person for marketing.

- Professional proficiency in English; other European languages are a plus.

- Familiarity with EMEA marketing environment: complexities, cultural/localisation considerations, local regulatory/industry nuances, regional media/partner ecosystem.

- (Bonus) Experience working with channel/partner marketing or co-marketing programmes with local partners.

What’s in it for you?

- Equity participation in our innovative mission to combat financial crime Unlimited Time Off Policy to promote work-life balance and well-being

- We embrace a hybrid approach that requires employees to be in the office for two days a week. We strongly believe that this approach fosters collaboration and enables the building of meaningful relationships

jobs.title: Sales Director, New Business APAC
jobs.description:
Sales Director, New Business APAC

Build and lead the team that wins ComplyAdvantage's next generation of customers across Asia-Pacific.

Who we are

Our values:

- Make a safer world. Our mission is to neutralize financial crime and protect the global financial ecosystem.

- Raise the bar. We are committed to constant improvement, pushing the limits of our AI technology and performance.

- See it, own it, drive it forward. We empower our people to take initiative, identify opportunities, and execute solutions with full accountability.

- Win as one team. Success is a collective effort; we collaborate across functions, hubs, and borders to achieve our goals.

ComplyAdvantage is the financial industry's leading source of AI-driven financial crime risk data and detection technology. Our mission is to make a safer world by neutralizing the risk of money laundering, terrorist financing, corruption, and other financial crimes.

More than 1,000 companies rely on us to understand who they're doing business with, powered by a global, real-time database of people and companies. Our solutions surface thousands of risk events daily from millions of structured and unstructured data points.

We have five global hubs — New York, London, Singapore, Lisbon, and Cluj-Napoca — and are backed by Goldman Sachs, Ontario Teachers, Index Ventures, and Balderton Capital.

The opportunity

APAC is one of the fastest-growing regions for ComplyAdvantage, and it needs a sales leader to build the engine that scales it.

We're looking for a Sales Director to run our new business function across the region: developing pipeline through a team of two Business Development Representatives (BDRs), converting it through a team of four Account Executives (AEs), and carrying the number for new-logo acquisition across APAC.

You'll report to the Managing Director (MD), with your two BDRs and four AEs reporting into you. This is a "see it, own it, drive it forward" role: you're not inheriting a fixed playbook, you're building the team, the standards, and the operating rhythm that will define how ComplyAdvantage wins new business in the region for years to come.

What you'll be doing

Own the new business number for APAC. Carry accountability for new-logo acquisition across the region, from qualified pipeline through to closed-won revenue. Drive average deal value up through stronger qualification and multi-threading, and identify early cross-sell and expansion opportunities across our product suite, including transaction monitoring, agentic AI, and ongoing screening.

Build and lead the team. Recruit exceptional people into your team of two BDRs and four AEs, and sell them on the mission - you are part of what they're choosing. Coach in a way that builds independent operators rather than dependence: develop your team through data-driven feedback, regular development planning, and a player-coach presence on live deals, while giving people the room to work things out for themselves.

Build the regional operating rhythm. Stand up the standards that let the function scale in APAC: qualification criteria, territory planning, accurate forecasting, and pipeline and CRM hygiene, alongside onboarding and enablement paths built specifically for a new-business motion.

Win as one team across functions and geographies. Partner with Revenue Operations, Marketing, and Enterprise on inbound routing, thresholds, and nurture programs, and maintain a feedback loop to Product and to our global commercial leadership so APAC's insights shape the wider go-to-market strategy. Adopt and help refine the AI-assisted tools and workflows being built centrally, adapting them to what works for the region.

Represent APAC in the room. Engage senior decision-makers at fintechs, payment companies, banks, and credit unions across the region, and act as ComplyAdvantage's voice in strategic regional conversations.

What you'll bring

We're looking for a builder with commercial range - someone who can carry a new-business number and stand up the team and system that produce it.

- Proven sales leadership experience, ideally in SaaS, cloud, fintech, or regtech, with the instincts of a player-coach.

- A track record of building or scaling a new business function, including hiring, ramping, and coaching BDRs and AEs.

- A track record of growing new-business revenue in a B2B environment, with some exposure to cross-sell or expansion motions.

- Value-based selling and qualification rigor: you map solutions to real business pain, and you're comfortable qualifying out when the pain or the champion isn't there.

- Live and breathe MEDDIC, embedding it into the team’s sales process and holding the team accountable to its consistent execution

- A coaching philosophy that develops independent operators — you give people space to figure things out, with the inspection cadence to keep them on track.

- Comfort with ambiguity and a fast-changing environment: proactive, resilient, and entrepreneurial.

- The credibility to engage senior decision-makers at fintechs, payment companies, banks, and credit unions, and to represent APAC in strategic discussions with global leadership.

- Data fluency: you run the business on clean numbers, forecast accurately, and make territory and prioritization decisions analytically.

- A commitment to raise the bar and win as one team, demonstrating the cultural attributes needed to thrive in a high-growth, collaborative environment.

Benefits:

- Equity as we want you to have a part of what we are building

- Unlimited Time Off Policy- A work-life balance and focus on our well-being are critical to keep us performing at our best

- Access to our Employee Assistance Programme to support you and your family’s wellbeing

- Medical Insurance including enhanced Dental and Vision support

- Annual learning budget to drive your performance and career development

- Budget to set up your home office upon joining
